```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", eval = FALSE)
```

Search the checked catalog or the live portals of six Tampa Bay publishers.
Layers marked `discovered` have not had the catalog checks.

The checked example runs offline. Live examples need internet access.

## Start offline

```{r checked-catalog, eval=TRUE}
library(tampaBayOpenData)

tampaBayOpenData::tbod_list_portals()[, c("id", "publisher", "jurisdiction")]
tampaBayOpenData::tbod_list_datasets(source = "checked")[,
  c("id", "title", "jurisdiction", "validation_status")]
tampaBayOpenData::tbod_search_datasets(
  "park", source = "checked", spatial = TRUE,
  jurisdiction = c("stpete", "clearwater")
)
tampaBayOpenData::tbod_dataset_info("construction-permits")[
  c("title", "scope_note", "verified")]
```

Choose a layer by title and jurisdiction, then use its dataset `id`.

`tbod_dataset_info(id)` gives its scope, terms, source URL, and endpoint
check date. See [coverage](coverage.html) for catalog limits.

## Search terms

Search ignores case and looks across catalog fields. All query words must
match. A limited spelling fallback applies only to checked entries; an empty
query lists datasets.

Title and ID matches rank first. Ranking helps locate sources; check
whether each source fits your question.

```{r checked-search-ranking, eval=TRUE}
tbod_search_datasets("permit", source = "checked", limit = 5)[,
  c("id", "title", "publisher")]
tbod_search_datasets("permti", source = "checked", limit = 5)[,
  c("id", "title", "publisher")]
tbod_search_datasets("", source = "checked", limit = 5)[,
  c("id", "title", "publisher")]
```

Compare `permit`, the typo `permti`, and an empty query.

`limit` caps returned rows after search and filtering. `max_items` caps
service items scanned per live portal. Neither guarantees a complete search.

## Search live portals

```{r live-search}
found <- tbod_search_datasets("housing", source = "live", portals = "city")
found[, c("id", "title", "publisher", "validation_status", "modified")]

# A one-row result carries the source needed for inspection or retrieval.
if (nrow(found)) {
  selected <- found[1, ]
  selected[, c("item_id", "service_url", "layer_id", "portal")]
  tbod_dataset_info(selected)
}
```

Each row is a layer. Inspect its metadata before retrieval.

The default `source = "all"` combines live results with the checked catalog.
Use `"live"` for portal results or `"checked"` for the offline catalog.
Matching endpoints appear once with checked status.

`tbod_list_portals()` lists publisher codes. Use `portals` to select live
publishers, or `jurisdiction` to filter both live and checked results.

New IDs use `arcgis:<item-id>:<layer-id>` and work with `tbod_get_dataset()`.

## Search another ArcGIS source

`tbod_discover()` accepts a public portal, service, or layer URL and returns
rows you can pass to `tbod_get_dataset()`. Portal results are `discovered`;
direct service results are `not_checked`.

```{r custom-discovery}
# Replace this example address with your portal's public sharing REST root.
portal <- "https://example.maps.arcgis.com/sharing/rest"
other <- tbod_discover(portal, query = "parks", max_items = 10)
if (nrow(other)) {
  data <- tbod_get_dataset(other[1, ], limit = 100)
  # A stable ArcGIS ID can also be resolved later through its own portal.
  same_layer <- tbod_get_dataset(other$id[[1]], portal = portal, limit = 100)
}
```

Set `publisher` and `jurisdiction` during discovery when known. To resolve
an `arcgis:` ID from a custom portal later, pass that portal on retrieval.

## Filter results

Both catalog functions accept these optional filters:

| Filter | Match |
| --- | --- |
| `jurisdiction` | One or more codes from `tbod_list_portals()`; default `"all"`. |
| `publisher` | Exact publisher names from `tbod_list_portals()`, ignoring case. |
| `validation_status` | `"checked"` or `"discovered"`. |
| `spatial` | `TRUE` for geometry layers, `FALSE` for tables; unknown geometry is excluded when filtering. |
| `topic` | Literal substring in tags and categories, ignoring case. |
| `category` | Exact category path or final category label, ignoring case. |
| `modified_after`, `modified_before` | Inclusive bounds on the catalog's `modified` timestamp. |

Values within one filter are alternatives; separate filters must all match.
Date bounds accept `Date`, `"YYYY-MM-DD"` (UTC days), or `POSIXct` values.
Rows with unknown dates are excluded when a date filter is used.

```{r county-search}
county_transport <- tbod_search_datasets(
  "road", source = "live", jurisdiction = "pinellas", spatial = TRUE,
  topic = "transportation", modified_after = as.Date("2025-01-01"),
  max_items = 10
)
county_transport[, c("id", "title", "publisher", "modified", "modified_source")]
```

`modified` dates a portal item or saved catalog snapshot, not every record.
`verified` dates an endpoint check.

## Check scan completeness

Live scans default to 25 service items per publisher. Set `max_items = Inf`
with a suitable `total_timeout` to scan all available pages. A capped scan
can miss matches, including matches for filters applied after discovery.

```{r scan-metadata}
results <- tbod_list_datasets(source = "live", portals = "stpete", max_items = 10)
attr(results, "discovery_complete")
attr(results, "discovery_truncated_portals")
attr(results, "discovery_scanned_items")
attr(results, "discovery_issues")
attr(results, "discovery_failed_portals")
```

If `discovery_complete` is `FALSE`, inspect the other diagnostics for
truncated or failed portals.

Even a complete scan covers only indexed public services. If every portal
fails without returning rows, `source = "live"` errors; `source = "all"`
warns and returns checked rows.
